description.narrative: CDCís $30 million directed lending facility to Tata Cleantech Capital Ltd. (TCCL) is expected to (1) avoid greenhouse gas emissions by increasing deployment of energy efficiency and e-mobility solutions to support climate change mitigation; and (2) reduce freshwater consumption by increasing deployment of water efficiency and wastewater treatment projects to reduce water stress for consumers and ecosystems. The facility is also expected to support the sustainable development of resource efficiency sectors in India by helping demonstrate the bankability of resource efficiency financing.
